title: Downtime paper form
description: A pre-printed paper form used while the record system is down: a title and form number, a patient label box (blank or filled with a synthetic patient), optional labeled fields, a ruled table with some handwritten sample rows and blank lines, and a line saying the form is entered into the record after recovery. Covers order sheets, requisitions, nursing flowsheets and registration forms.

patient.description: Patient label contents. Omit to print an empty label box. Synthetic only.

fields.description: Labeled boxes above the table (for example registration items). Value empty for a blank box.

filledRows.description: Handwritten sample rows, one value per column (up to 8).

blankRows.description: Number of empty ruled rows after the filled ones (0 to 20).

instructions.description: Short numbered instructions printed on the form.
